lcc_original: 上帝把這些發光之體佈置在天穹，讓它們照在地上，
notes: UNV {<WAH0430>} is implicit (no explicit '神' subject), but LCC has explicit '上帝' → dropped braces per rule 3
LCC '天穹' (sky-vault) maps to UNV '天空' (sky-expanse): split SNs character-by-character as 天<WH08064>穹<WAH09002><WH07549>, paralleling UNV's 天<WH08064>空<WAH09002><WH07549>
LCC '讓它們照' rephrases UNV '普照' (Hiphil infinitive לְהָאִיר → causative 'let them shine'); all three tags <WAH09001><WH0215><WTH8687> attached to 照 as the semantic verb
'讓它們' (let them) has no direct Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated per rule 5
